نزدوج (form VIII)
# نَزْدَوِجُ (nazdawiju) /naz.da.wi.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَوَجَ (izdawaja)
# نَزْدَوِجَ (nazdawija) /naz.da.wi.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَوَجَ (izdawaja)
# نَزْدَوِجْ (nazdawij) /naz.da.wid͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِزْدَوَجَ (izdawaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
